scope: Static token-budget and representational-capacity audit of registered small-corpus pilot; no experiment changes.

drivor.native_scene_register_selection: Additional scene registers after all ViT blocks; patch tokens remain inside the image encoder.

jepa.compression: adaptive_avg_pool1d followed by Linear1024->256; custom pilot interface

caveats: Equal planner tensor shape does not equate encoder representation capacity, compute or retained information.
Reducing LPWM particle count changes upstream representation and dynamics, whereas register count controls summary slots alongside dense image patches.
Small appearance dimension alone is not total information capacity: geometry, context and predicted state also enter planner.
One particle is not guaranteed to represent exactly one semantic object.
JEPA512->16 averaging may itself reduce baseline quality; original paper planner is not reproduced.
Sixteen LPWM particles were chosen for fast screening and planning adequacy has not been established.

recommendation.priority: Complete the registered16-token pilot; propose additional particle-budget controls separately.
recommendation.aggregation: Apply the same aggregation design to every particle-count condition, including16, with matched decoder architecture and initialization policy.
recommendation.controls: Same public initialization policy, clips/scenes, exposure, optimizer schedule, downstream architecture and evaluation scenes; do not simply enlarge16-particle weights mid-run.
recommendation.optional_followup: Memory-token sweep across all model types and PDMS-versus-cost curves.

paper_reference.register_count_ablation: 5,8,16,32 random scene-token settings; 16 selected after16-32 plateau; paper navval ViT-S settings differ from this pilot.
